title: A price gap can disappear at checkout
script: The lowest item price can lose at checkout. Illustrative example: R120 plus R45 delivery totals R165. The same item at R135 with R10 delivery totals R145. In this example, the higher item price costs R20 less overall. Compare equivalent products and the final total. Start your next price check at Cwhereucheaper.co.za.
caption: Illustrative arithmetic, not current retailer offers: R120 + R45 = R165; R135 + R10 = R145. Match the exact product and include delivery before deciding.
